item.title: Rome Police investigating Court Street vehicle-versus-pedestrian accident
item.description: Rome Police are asking for the public's help in an accident Tuesday morning, which left one person critically injured.

item.title: Eyewitness Sports Scoreboard for Wednesday, February 4
item.description: We are heading into the last weeks of the high school sports regular season, and all over Central New York, teams continue to fight for at least one last home game! We had a full docket in several sports on Tuesday night, and you can catch up with the latest scores on the Wednesday edition of the Eyewitness Sports Scoreboard!

item.title: India Walton to be Antonio Delgado's running mate in NY Democratic primary
item.description: Lieutenant Governor Antonio Delgado has announced his running mate for the New York gubernatorial Democratic primary. According to his announcement Wednesday morning, India Walton, an activist and nurse from Buffalo, will be his running mate.

item.title: NY State Senate GOP want New York's taxpayers to 'keep what they've earned'
item.description: New York Republican State Senators have proposed a legislative package to cut income and property taxes, limit government spending, and provide tax relief for families and businesses.

item.title: NY bill lets religious groups bypass zoning for housing on holy land
item.description: Faith leaders and Democratic lawmakers in New York are pushing for the Faith-Based Affordable Housing Act, which would allow religious organizations to build affordable housing on their property, bypassing local zoning restrictions and potentially creating 60,000 new homes statewide over the next decade.
